tmdb_overview: 隧道的另一端，是一個不可思議的地方！一個不可能有的地點，一個不可能的事情竟然發生。10歲的少女千尋和父母，被捲入人類不能踏入的世界。在這個處處令人驚訝的地方，千尋感受到強大的無力感……和渺小的希望。 讓我在這裡工作吧！為解救被變成動物的父母，千尋求生的力量原本是沉睡的，現在終於被喚醒！
tmdb_overview_en: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

synopsis: 他們為了什麼在千呎絕壁上命懸一繩？ 加拿大雪峰頂，埋藏著一個舊鐵盒，紀錄下一段跨越國界與生死的冒險故事。 徐耀群是台灣極具代表性的登山家之一，來自加拿大的Patrick Lindsay，則是他並肩攀登的夥伴，也是相知一生的摯友。2022年，徐耀群於玉山東峰北壁攀登時不幸墜落身亡，留下尚未完成的攀登心願，以及帶領台灣新一代攀登者持續前行的志向。導演王一訢同時是徐耀群與Patrick的學生，也因此踏上追尋這段故事的旅程。 Patrick帶領一支由台灣與加拿大攀登者組成的跨國隊伍，再度挑戰玉山東峰北壁。颱風、惡劣氣候與死亡的陰影接踵而來，在危險與掙扎之間，他們逐漸明白，這不僅是一場攀登，更是一段兄弟情誼與冒險精神的傳承。最終，攀登隊成功開闢出一條全新的路線，並命名為「Shiu(徐) be here」，讓徐耀群的名字再次留在他曾經熱愛的山壁上。 電影預告
tmdb_overview: 他們為了什麼在千呎絕壁上命懸一繩？加拿大雪峰頂，埋藏著一個舊鐵盒，裡頭的字條記下一段跨越國界與生死的冒險故事。徐耀群是臺灣最具代表性的登山家之一，來自加拿大的Patrick Lindsay是他的攀登夥伴、一生摯友。耀群死於2022年玉山東峰北壁上的一場墜落，留下了未竟之志。導演王一訢同時是他們的學生，進而展開了追尋。Patrick帶領著跨國攀登隊，挑戰玉山東峰北壁。颱風、惡劣氣候與死亡陰影考驗著團隊，在危險與掙扎中，他們理解這不僅是一場攀登，更是一段兄弟情誼與冒險精神的傳承。攀登隊在北壁上開闢一條全新路線，並命名為「Shiu（徐）be here」，耀群雖不在場卻始終同在。三年後，Patrick再度返回埋藏鐵盒的雪峰頂，再沒留下遺憾，只是凝望雪峰，低語：「下座峰頂見。」
tmdb_overview_en: Why risk everything on a thousand-foot cliff? After legendary Taiwanese climber Shiu Yau Chiun's fatal accident, his Canadian climbing partner Patrick Lindsay and student (the director) lead a cross-border team back to Yushan's East Peak North Face. Battling storms and grief, they establish a new route, “Shiu Be Here,” honoring their friend. Years later, Patrick returns to a remote Canadian summit, whispering, “See you on the next peak.”

synopsis: 坎城影展最佳導演獎 雪梨影展國際劇情片GIO觀眾票選獎 當代大師佩卓阿莫多瓦監製╳西班牙酷兒「哈維爾雙人組」執導 改編自西班牙詩人加爾西亞羅卡未完成的同名殘稿 不同時代裡彼此交織的三個人生，歌頌橫跨世紀的酷兒歷史 西班牙內戰轉折時刻，佛朗哥軍營的小號手受命照顧戰俘，面對瑰麗胴體和慾望初萌，一段愛情也隨著戰事拉扯；出身貴族的酷兒因陰性氣質無法躋身上流，更被迫肩負著家族責任；新銳劇作家返鄉之際，接獲剛逝世祖父所留下的遺產，追尋著未曾言說的過去……1932、1937、2017，跨越三個年代，交織三個不同命運，在國家暴力、酷兒認同與歷史創傷的鴻溝裡彼此映照，譜寫一則傳誦愛的跨時代史詩。 Explores what it means to be gay throughout different eras, focusing on "three existences" that are connected through themes of sexuality, desire, pain, and inheritance.

tmdb_overview_en: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

tmdb_overview: 一個巴勒斯坦少年的生命危在旦夕，急切需要做手術，但約旦河西岸境內的醫院並沒有適當的設備，就連檢查都無法提供。然而，離開西岸到鄰近國家求醫並非容易之事，武裝衝突、族群間的差別待遇、繁瑣的官僚程序……一一都是病人面對的障礙。橫跨幾代人的衝突不只是展現在街頭上，潛藏的阻撓和暴力也能致命於無形。《被消失的家園》以一家三代的故事，描繪出在西岸生活的巴勒斯坦人多年來的重擔，個人記憶背後更是集體歷史與回憶。
tmdb_overview_en: After a Palestinian teen gets swept up into a West Bank protest, his mother recounts the family story of hope, courage and relentless struggle that led to this fateful moment.

director: A Heart-to-Heart with the Dalai Lama
director_en: A Heart-to-Heart with the Dalai Lama
synopsis: 菲力浦德拉奎斯 Philip Delaquis --------------------------------------- 2024 | English | Color | USA/ Switzerland | 90min | C/E Subtitles | 護 李察吉爾監製 歷時六年攝製完成 一場最親密、喜悅的觀影體驗 《與達賴喇嘛談心：尋找幸福的智慧》是一部深刻動人的全新紀錄片，以極具電影感的手法探索達賴喇嘛最內在的精神世界，呼應當代人心的渴望與挑戰。透過一場宛如貼心交談的近距離對話，這位全球最具影響力的慈悲代言人，邀請我們一同踏上一段追尋幸福本源的心靈旅程。 站在人生91年高峰的當下，達賴喇嘛回望自4歲被認定即踏入世界聚光燈下的命運軌跡，省思如何在動盪的現代社會中，將千年藏傳佛教的智慧與全球化價值觀調和共存。當這個世界正陷於戰火與暴力、瀕臨環境崩潰邊緣，這位第一位因呼籲環境保護而獲得諾貝爾和平獎的精神領袖，堅定地傳遞一種信念：我們擁有改變未來、創造更健康、更幸福世界的能力，而實現這一切的工具，其實早已掌握在我們每個人手中。 憑藉寬闊的心智與幽默的語調，達賴喇嘛將他漫長又複雜的修行智慧，化為清澈簡明的指引，激勵我們重新思考：建構和平與繁榮的社會，其實並不遙遠。幸福源自每個人內心，但唯有培養無條件的慈悲，我們才能真正轉化這個世界。 這極可能是達賴喇嘛最後一次於電影中現身。由芭芭拉米勒、菲力浦德拉奎斯、曼努鮑爾、歐倫莫瓦曼與李察吉爾聯手打造的《與達賴喇嘛談心：尋找幸福的智慧》，以靜謐詩意的影像語言、前所未見的珍貴影像檔案，以及深度近身的拍攝視角，引領觀眾踏上一段由苦難之谷攀向智慧高峰的冥想旅程，啟發心靈與視野的全新轉化。 Dalai Lama, talks directly to camera about inner peace, happiness, and potential for peaceful, happy 21st century.
tmdb_title_local: 與達賴喇嘛談心：尋找幸福的智慧
tmdb_overview: 一部以達賴喇嘛為主角的紀錄片，聚焦於他關於內心平靜與幸福的教誨，並探討這些智慧如何成為我們面對21世紀挑戰的指引。
tmdb_overview_en: A deeply intimate and highly cinematic documentary featuring the Dalai Lama, who, at nearly ninety year of age, offers practical advice for navigating the 21st century's challenges.

synopsis: ★ 橫掃波蘭電影獎四項大獎 波蘭影史罕見巨製 ★ 李斯特、喬治桑、法國國王 巴黎藝術名流齊聚一堂！ ★ 19世紀的超級搖滾巨星 你從未見過的鋼琴詩人 ★ 「浪漫、華麗、非凡，令人深深著迷！」── Variety 1835年的巴黎，25歲的蕭邦早已是風靡上流社會的超級巨星。貴族為他傾倒，法國國王邀他演奏，巴黎最時髦的派對少不了他的身影，堪稱夜生活之王。白天授課、創作，夜晚流連沙龍與宴會，在愛情、友情與名流生活間恣意穿梭。即使疾病逐漸侵蝕身體，他仍以幽默掩飾脆弱，拒絕停下腳步，在生命倒數中寫下一首首傳世之作，直到終於明白，音樂才是他無法割捨的愛。

synopsis: 歌仔戲天王楊麗花，是跨越一世紀的「國民偶像」，也是許多媽媽的「世紀初戀」。 她以俊俏小生與帝王英雄形象深植人心，一生視歌仔戲為終身情人；不僅引領歌仔戲從內台走向電視螢幕，更一路登上國父紀念館、國家戲劇院與小巨蛋，魅力橫跨廣播、電視與電影，風靡全球華人社群。 如今82歲的她，將透過紀錄片回望璀璨生涯，獻給觀眾一生絕無僅有的初戀—歌仔戲的世紀告白。 電影預告 其他熱映

synopsis_en: Yang Li-hua, the legendary superstar of Taiwanese Opera, is a "national idol" whose influence spans a century and who remains the "first love of the century" for generations of mothers. Renowned for her iconic portrayals of handsome male leads, emperors, and heroes, she has dedicated her life to Taiwanese Opera, regarding it as her lifelong lover. She spearheaded the evolution of the art form from traditional stages to the television screen, eventually bringing it to prestigious venues like the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, the National Theater, and the Taipei Arena. Her charisma has transcended radio, television, and film, captivating Chinese communities across the globe. Now 82, she reflects on her illustrious career in this documentary, presenting a "confession of the century" to her one-and-only first love: Taiwanese Opera.

synopsis: 菲力浦德拉奎斯 Philip Delaquis --------------------------------------- 2024 | English | Color | USA/ Switzerland | 90min | C/E Subtitles | 護 李察吉爾監製 歷時六年攝製完成 一場最親密、喜悅的觀影體驗 《與達賴喇嘛談心：尋找幸福的智慧》是一部深刻動人的全新紀錄片，以極具電影感的手法探索達賴喇嘛最內在的精神世界，呼應當代人心的渴望與挑戰。透過一場宛如貼心交談的近距離對話，這位全球最具影響力的慈悲代言人，邀請我們一同踏上一段追尋幸福本源的心靈旅程。 站在人生91年高峰的當下，達賴喇嘛回望自4歲被認定即踏入世界聚光燈下的命運軌跡，省思如何在動盪的現代社會中，將千年藏傳佛教的智慧與全球化價值觀調和共存。當這個世界正陷於戰火與暴力、瀕臨環境崩潰邊緣，這位第一位因呼籲環境保護而獲得諾貝爾和平獎的精神領袖，堅定地傳遞一種信念：我們擁有改變未來、創造更健康、更幸福世界的能力，而實現這一切的工具，其實早已掌握在我們每個人手中。 憑藉寬闊的心智與幽默的語調，達賴喇嘛將他漫長又複雜的修行智慧，化為清澈簡明的指引，激勵我們重新思考：建構和平與繁榮的社會，其實並不遙遠。幸福源自每個人內心，但唯有培養無條件的慈悲，我們才能真正轉化這個世界。 這極可能是達賴喇嘛最後一次於電影中現身。由芭芭拉米勒、菲力浦德拉奎斯、曼努鮑爾、歐倫莫瓦曼與李察吉爾聯手打造的《與達賴喇嘛談心：尋找幸福的智慧》，以靜謐詩意的影像語言、前所未見的珍貴影像檔案，以及深度近身的拍攝視角，引領觀眾踏上一段由苦難之谷攀向智慧高峰的冥想旅程，啟發心靈與視野的全新轉化。 Dalai Lama, talks directly to camera about inner peace, happiness, and potential for peaceful, happy 21st century.

synopsis_en:
1953 Venice Film Festival – In Competition
1976 International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR)

Near the end of World War II, a Japanese vessel is sunk by U.S. forces. Over a dozen survivors drift to a remote Pacific island, where they begin a long period of coexistence with the only two inhabitants: a man and a woman. Even after Japan’s surrender, the group dismisses surrender leaflets as enemy propaganda, choosing to remain in isolation. While the island is free from the global war, the conflict within their hearts never ceases; military rank fails to maintain order, and repressed desire breeds resentment. The men fight for the affection of the sole woman, leading to a spiral of suspicion and violent infighting.

A late masterpiece by Josef von Sternberg, the renowned director of *The Blue Angel*, the film is based on the true events of Anatahan Island. Filmed in a Kyoto studio within a meticulously constructed artificial jungle, Sternberg uses the interplay of light and shadow to create a primal theater of human nature. At the time of its release, the Japanese dialogue was intentionally left untranslated. Instead, the director provided a detached English narration to recount the events and interpret the characters' emotions, mimicking the effect of an ethnographic commentary. This creates a relationship between sound and image that is both complementary and alienating—a cold observation of the collapse of civilization, where humans are driven by desire like a queen bee and her drones. Although the film was never released in Taiwan, the real-life incident was an international sensation, inspiring the "lone beauty on a deserted island" narrative seen in films like *Queen Bee of the Island*. It was also selected by François Truffaut of *Cahiers du Cinéma* as one of the ten greatest American sound films.

synopsis: 榮民之子伍子明學成歸國，巧遇潑辣漁女，竟是房東女兒周小梅。子明聽從父意，留在新生地為農田設計水渠，與小梅朝夕相處，海濱散步，漸生情愫。然而，伍父盼子明與同鄉護士交往，周母對女兒的郎君人選亦另有屬意，子明動了他念，小梅卻執意追愛。村裡謠言四起、工程遭人反對，這段感情終將歸向何處？ 黨國元老吳忠信之子吳申叔出資，委由中影攝製的寬銀幕大作。以新竹海埔新生地為背景，捕捉海岸實景、展示集體勞動，已見健康寫實概念雛形。然而影片對身體與慾望的感官呈現，既透出歐日電影風情，亦顯現彼時台灣青年的束縛。攝影師洪慶雲回憶受《男人之禁地》第三集《紅短褲》啟發，試驗水中攝影並於片中實踐。本片歷經60多年，迎來大銀幕首獻。 After his studies overseas, a young engineer meets a spirited fisherwoman who turns out to be his landlady’s daughter. At his father’s urging, he stays in a newly reclaimed coastal settlement to design irrigation channels, and the two gradually fall in love. But parental expectations, competing romantic prospects, village gossip, and opposition to the construction project threaten to derail their burgeoning romance. The film’s planned 1960 release never materialised. After six decades on the shelf, this hidden gem finally makes its big-screen debut.

synopsis_en:
Wu Zi-ming, the son of a veteran, returns home after completing his studies abroad and encounters a feisty fisherwoman who turns out to be his landlady’s daughter, Chou Hsiao-mei. At his father’s request, Zi-ming stays in the newly reclaimed land to design irrigation channels for the farmland. Spending their days together and taking walks along the shore, he and Hsiao-mei gradually develop feelings for one another. However, Zi-ming’s father hopes he will date a nurse from their hometown, while Hsiao-mei’s mother has another suitor in mind for her daughter. As Zi-ming begins to waver, Hsiao-mei remains determined to pursue her love. With village gossip swirling and opposition mounting against the engineering project, where will their relationship lead?

This widescreen epic was funded by Wu Shen-shu, son of the Kuomintang elder Wu Zhong-xin, and commissioned to the Central Motion Picture Corporation (CMPC). Set against the backdrop of Hsinchu’s reclaimed coastal land, the film captures authentic seaside scenery and collective labor, showcasing the early seeds of the "Healthy Realism" movement. Yet, its sensory portrayal of the body and desire reflects both European and Japanese cinematic influences, as well as the societal constraints faced by Taiwanese youth at the time. Cinematographer Hung Ching-yun recalled being inspired by *Red Shorts* (the third installment of the documentary *Forbidden Paradise*) to experiment with and implement underwater photography in the film. After more than 60 years, this film finally makes its big-screen debut.

synopsis: 孤女 瑪麗娜 打漁維生，一場意外奪走小船，幸得漁民 皮耶洛 救回小命，也牽起一段歡喜冤家情。為了攢錢買船，她轉往鹽田做工， 皮耶洛 亦為愛相隨。豈料鹽場比大海更不平靜，工頭騷擾、女工暗妒、追求者癡心守候，接連掀起情海波折。 本片當年在台熱映，本地影評視為「新寫實」美學，誤認故事在義大利。實為西德、南斯拉夫主導的跨國借殼製作，片方借南斯拉夫相似地景，打造具國際賣相的義式風情；風格沿襲《慾海奇花》通俗路線，並由黑色調性轉為青春明亮，顯現新寫實被商業體制吸納變形，甚至跟原真土地脫鉤。全片唯一義籍 核心成員 為傳奇影星馬切洛馬斯楚安尼，化身粗獷又孩子氣的熱情漁工，展現與費里尼片中知性風采迥異的草根帥氣。 *本片拷貝由 德國 威斯巴登 穆瑙基金會典藏。

Shochiku, a studio traditionally known for its refined literary style, made a rare strategic shift toward more provocative content in response to the growing trend of eroticism in the domestic film market. By emulating Italian cinema, the studio transformed the documentary realism and serious themes of tradition versus modernity found in earlier *ama* (diver) films into a Westernized, sensual commercial aesthetic. This marked a pivotal turning point in the eroticization of the Japanese diver genre. Newcomer Kyoko Izumi’s seductive image was even marketed as the "Japanese Silvana Mangano." The film was a massive box-office success, prompting Shochiku to produce a string of sequels with increasingly explicit nudity, a trend that only ended after facing a backlash from the film classification board, Eirin.

Notably, the film’s skilled underwater photography highlights the female form; while the divers' sheer white garments and scenes of women fighting carry erotic markers, the mystery and the eerie atmosphere of the haunted house remain the narrative's true focus. The "Ama" identity serves as a symbolic framework to showcase the screen presence of stars Yoko Mihara and Masayo Banri.

synopsis_en:
1949 Cannes Film Festival – Competition
1951 Academy Awards – Nominated for Best Writing (Motion Picture Story)
2025 Il Cinema Ritrovato, Bologna

As the planting season arrives, female laborers crowd onto trains, heading to the northern plains to work the rice paddies. Francesca, carrying jewelry stolen by her lover, hides among them to evade the law. There, she meets a glamorous farm girl who yearns for a life of luxury and an upright soldier. Just as she begins to adapt to rural life and develops new feelings, her former lover suddenly reappears. His presence not only heightens the tension of a complex romantic quadrangle but also conceals a secret plan for another heist.

While Italian Neorealism is typically known for its "austere" style, *Bitter Rice* defies this reputation. Rooted in themes of unemployment, labor disputes, and collective resistance, the film weaves in elements of film noir, erotic desire, and star charisma, allowing leftist social concerns and commercial thrills to flourish side-by-side in the rice fields. In the early 1950s, it became the highest-grossing foreign film in American history, establishing iconic tropes for "ama" (sea girl) cinema, such as women fighting in the mud and showing off their legs while planting rice. Actress Silvana Mangano shot to stardom with her role as a peasant girl; her sultry image in shorts and black stockings remains one of the most enduring symbols of post-war Italian cinema.

* 4K Restored DCP provided by Fondazione Cineteca di Bologna.
* Poster image courtesy of Museo Nazionale del Cinema – Turin.

synopsis_en:
1953 Venice Film Festival – In Competition
1976 International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR)

Near the end of World War II, a Japanese vessel is sunk by U.S. forces. Over a dozen survivors drift to a remote Pacific island, where they begin a long period of coexistence with the only two inhabitants: a man and a woman. Even after Japan’s surrender, the group dismisses surrender leaflets as enemy propaganda, choosing to remain in isolation. While the island is free from the global war, the conflict within their hearts never ceases; military rank fails to maintain order, and repressed desire breeds resentment. The men fight for the affection of the sole woman, leading to a spiral of suspicion and violent infighting.

A late masterpiece by Josef von Sternberg, the renowned director of *The Blue Angel*, the film is based on the true events of Anatahan Island. Filmed in a Kyoto studio within a meticulously constructed artificial jungle, Sternberg uses the interplay of light and shadow to create a primal theater of human nature. At the time of its release, the Japanese dialogue was intentionally left untranslated. Instead, the director provided a detached English narration to recount the events and interpret the characters' emotions, mimicking the effect of an ethnographic commentary. This creates a relationship between sound and image that is both complementary and alienating—a cold observation of the collapse of civilization, where humans are driven by desire like a queen bee and her drones. Although the film was never released in Taiwan, the real-life incident was an international sensation, inspiring the "lone beauty on a deserted island" narrative seen in films like *Queen Bee of the Island*. It was also selected by François Truffaut of *Cahiers du Cinéma* as one of the ten greatest American sound films.

tmdb_overview: 故事主角羅伊乃(理查德·德萊福斯 飾)一名電子工程師，有一天他接受一樁緊急裝修任務時，遇到了幽浮，並被它所發出的光所灼傷，但他的家人全部不相信他的說辭。可是羅伊拒絕所有「合理的答案」，他要家人和他一起探索所謂的「真相」。 他廣蒐情報，和有類似遭遇的人交換經驗，尋找辦法和外星人接觸……許是他的誠心感動，他終於和外星人的太空船有了近距離的接觸…… 而此同時，一位來自法國的研究員提議，他們不妨用音樂和外星人溝通……於是他們找出最適合的音律和外星人對話…… 此片由當代大導演史蒂芬史匹柏編寫與執導，音樂大師約翰威廉斯配樂，此片有別於一般外星人的恐怖電影，它以溫馨、樂觀而神聖的氣氛，描繪接觸 外星人的感覺，曾獲得1977年奧斯卡最佳攝影、最佳音響效果剪輯兩項大獎。

When he suddenly disappears without a trace, her world begins to unravel. To break free from the painful limbo, she places a personal ad in the newspaper, drawing an array of eccentric suitors—from one-night-stand seekers and cross-dressers to lonely retirees. As she navigates these absurd speed dates, she continues leaving desperate messages on her lover's answering machine, clinging to hope. Just as she decides to give up, an unexpected visitor reveals a devastating truth.

She quickly becomes friends with Janis, an artistic girl with a punk streak, and the gentle Damian. synopsis: 原文發音、中文字幕 — Bob 曾經是個國際巨星，但如今他的生活卻只有下坡。他遠赴日本東京拍攝一個三得利的廣告。 Charlotte 隨著攝影師丈夫來到東京出差，卻日復一日漫步在喧鬧的東京街頭。他們一樣的孤獨迷惘，一樣的在這個陌生失語的都市，渴望找到聆聽彼此的人。 漂浮搖晃的鏡頭，疏離冷調的淡綠色調、嘈雜混亂的城市喧鬧，映射的卻是最為純粹的愛情。孤獨，是愛情真正的樣貌；而迷失，是城市最迷人的姿態。 — Doors open 21:30｜Screening 22:00｜Runtime 1h 42m｜15+ Original audio, Chinese subtitles — Bob was once an international movie star. These days, his life seems to be heading in only one direction. He travels to Tokyo to film a commercial for Suntory. Charlotte has accompanied her photographer husband on a work trip, only to spend day after day wandering the city's crowded streets. They share the same loneliness, the same uncertainty. In a place where neither can quite find the words, each longs for someone who will listen. Drifting camerawork, cool shades of pale green, the restless noise of the city. Reflected in all of it is something as simple as love. Loneliness becomes its truest expression, and being lost becomes the city's most captivating quality. —

synopsis: 1964 亞洲影展最佳劇情片 Best Film, Asia-Pacific FF 西部海岸蚵村裡，蚵女阿蘭與漁夫金水相戀互許終身，好不容易盼得情郎歸來，金水卻因聘金不足，只得再次出海。阿蘭在蚵田勞動等待，村子則迎來一系列改變：新鄉長上任、養蚵技術改良、加工廠興建。蚵村在建設中日益茁壯，阿蘭處境反倒愈發艱難，腹肚漸起，地痞卻糾纏不已，流言蜚語更傳進父親耳裡⋯⋯。 中影「健康寫實」製片路線首作，也是首部全台人自製彩色寬銀幕電影，由華慧英掌鏡。健康寫實雖借鑑義大利新寫實主義，卻同時受官方意識形態與商業考量牽引，既向《慾海奇花》取經勞動大場面，也以健美高挑的王莫愁遙映《河孃淚》的蘇菲亞羅蘭，從而成就健康意識與場面奇觀、身體情慾並行的混雜之作。本次以正確寬銀幕比例放映，坊間難得一見。 In a coastal Taiwanese village, a young oyster farmer struggles to support her family while pursuing love with a local fisherman. As financial pressures and family obligations threaten their future, their relationship faces mounting challenges. Blending coastal labour, melodrama, and sensual imagery, this landmark of Taiwan’s "Healthy Realism" cinema reveals the movement’s tension between ideological agendas and commercial appeal.

synopsis: 孤女 瑪麗娜 打漁維生，一場意外奪走小船，幸得漁民 皮耶洛 救回小命，也牽起一段歡喜冤家情。為了攢錢買船，她轉往鹽田做工， 皮耶洛 亦為愛相隨。豈料鹽場比大海更不平靜，工頭騷擾、女工暗妒、追求者癡心守候，接連掀起情海波折。 本片當年在台熱映，本地影評視為「新寫實」美學，誤認故事在義大利。實為西德、南斯拉夫主導的跨國借殼製作，片方借南斯拉夫相似地景，打造具國際賣相的義式風情；風格沿襲《慾海奇花》通俗路線，並由黑色調性轉為青春明亮，顯現新寫實被商業體制吸納變形，甚至跟原真土地脫鉤。全片唯一義籍 核心成員 為傳奇影星馬切洛馬斯楚安尼，化身粗獷又孩子氣的熱情漁工，展現與費里尼片中知性風采迥異的草根帥氣。 *本片拷貝由 德國 威斯巴登 穆瑙基金會典藏。

synopsis: 出走五年後，作治回到家鄉，與海女凪再度相逢。當年凪活潑野性，引眾人傾慕，雖與作治兩情相悅，卻又應允他人求婚，令作治黯然遠走。如今凪成寡婦，戀情重燃希望，但凪的玩心未變，縱情歌舞享樂。此時，疏散而來的青年向凪求婚，她卻要求對方先成為頭號海人。 素以文藝見長的松竹，面對國內電影市場肉體化、情色風氣起，做出少有的製作轉向。過去海女電影的紀實特質、傳統與現代衝突等嚴肅命題，經仿效義大利電影後，轉化出洋派性感的商業風貌，成為日本海女電影色情化轉折點；新人泉京子挑逗形象更被宣傳為「⽇本曼卡諾」。本片票房回收甚豐，使松竹接連推出續集並加重裸露尺度，直到引發電影檢查機構「映倫」反彈才劃下句點。 After five years away, a fisherman returns to his hometown and reunites with an alluring woman diver he once loved, who had accepted another man’s proposal, prompting his departure. Now a widow, she renews her romance with her former lover, though her playful, pleasure-seeking nature remains unchanged. When a young newcomer proposes to her, she sets a condition: he must first become the village’s finest diver.

After five years away, Sakuji returns to his hometown and reunites with the female diver Nagi. Shochiku, a studio traditionally known for its refined literary style, made a rare strategic shift toward more provocative content in response to the growing trend of eroticism in the domestic film market. By emulating Italian cinema, the studio transformed the documentary realism and serious themes of tradition versus modernity found in earlier *ama* (diver) films into a Westernized, sensual commercial aesthetic. This marked a pivotal turning point in the eroticization of the Japanese diver genre. Newcomer Kyoko Izumi’s seductive image was even marketed as the "Japanese Silvana Mangano." The film was a massive box-office success, prompting Shochiku to produce a string of sequels with increasingly explicit nudity, a trend that only ended after facing a backlash from the film classification board, Eirin.

synopsis_en:
2010 Udine Far East Film Festival. Yumi, the mistress of a grand estate in the Aoiso Ama village, has recently been plagued by family misfortune and frequent ghostly sightings, leading her to seek help from a policewoman named Kyoko. Meanwhile, Yumi’s heirloom black pearl necklace is linked to a murder in Tokyo, drawing a detective to the village to investigate. At the same time, an expert hires local divers for research, though he appears to have a hidden agenda. Are the strange occurrences in the mansion the work of a vengeful spirit, or is someone playing a deceptive game?

As Shintoho’s "Ama" film series evolved, it embraced the rising trend of *kaidan* (ghost stories), demonstrating a clear shift toward genre-blending. Bunta Sugawara, who would later become a legend of yakuza cinema in Kinji Fukasaku’s *Battles Without Honor and Humanity*, portrays a young detective here, his ruggedness tempered by a touch of youth. Notably, the film’s skilled underwater photography highlights the female form; while the divers' sheer white garments and scenes of women fighting carry erotic markers, the mystery and the eerie atmosphere of the haunted house remain the narrative's true focus. The "Ama" identity serves as a symbolic framework to showcase the screen presence of stars Yoko Mihara and Masayo Banri.

As she navigates these absurd speed dates, she continues leaving desperate messages on her lover's answering machine, clinging to hope. Just as she decides to give up, an unexpected visitor reveals a devastating truth.

synopsis: 原文發音、中文字幕 — 1962 年，紐約。夜店暫時歇業，保鑣 Tony 需要一份工作。有人要他去見一位鋼琴家。 那位鋼琴家叫 Don Shirley，住在卡內基音樂廳樓上，談吐講究，要雇一個司機，帶他到美國南方巡演八週。 Tony 粗魯、話多、什麼都吃；Don 安靜、嚴謹、對每一個細節都有意見。他們唯一的共識是這趟路一定會很難熬。 而他們手上那本綠皮書，列著南方哪些旅館和餐廳願意接待黑人——它會告訴他們，這趟路到底有多難。 — Doors open 16:30｜Screening 17:30｜Runtime 2h 10m｜Parental Guidance Original audio, Mandarin subtitles — New York, 1962. The club has closed for refurbishment and Tony, a bouncer, needs work. Someone tells him to go and see a pianist. The pianist is Don Shirley. He lives above Carnegie Hall, chooses his words carefully, and is looking for a driver to take him on an eight-week tour of the American South. Tony is loud, rough and will eat anything. Don is quiet, exacting, and has an opinion about every detail. The one thing they agree on is that this trip is going to be difficult. And the Green Book on the seat between them — listing which hotels and restaurants in the South will take a Black traveller — is about to show them exactly how difficult. —

synopsis_en:
1949 Cannes Film Festival – Competition
1951 Academy Awards – Nominated for Best Writing (Motion Picture Story)
2025 Il Cinema Ritrovato, Bologna

As the planting season arrives, female laborers crowd onto trains, heading to the northern plains to work the rice paddies. Francesca, carrying jewelry stolen by her lover, hides among them to evade the law. There, she meets a glamorous farm girl who yearns for a life of luxury and an upright soldier. Just as she begins to adapt to rural life and develops new feelings, her former lover suddenly reappears. His presence not only heightens the tension of a complex romantic quadrangle but also conceals a secret plan for another heist.

While Italian Neorealism is typically known for its "austere" style, *Bitter Rice* defies this reputation. Rooted in themes of unemployment, labor disputes, and collective resistance, the film weaves in elements of film noir, erotic desire, and star charisma, allowing leftist social concerns and commercial thrills to flourish side-by-side in the rice fields. In the early 1950s, it became the highest-grossing foreign film in American history, establishing iconic tropes for "ama" (sea girl) cinema, such as women fighting in the mud and showing off their legs while planting rice. Actress Silvana Mangano shot to stardom with her role as a peasant girl; her sultry image in shorts and black stockings remains one of the most enduring symbols of post-war Italian cinema.

* 4K Restored DCP provided by Fondazione Cineteca di Bologna.
* Poster image courtesy of Museo Nazionale del Cinema – Turin.

synopsis: 1964 亞洲影展最佳劇情片 Best Film, Asia-Pacific FF 西部海岸蚵村裡，蚵女阿蘭與漁夫金水相戀互許終身，好不容易盼得情郎歸來，金水卻因聘金不足，只得再次出海。阿蘭在蚵田勞動等待，村子則迎來一系列改變：新鄉長上任、養蚵技術改良、加工廠興建。蚵村在建設中日益茁壯，阿蘭處境反倒愈發艱難，腹肚漸起，地痞卻糾纏不已，流言蜚語更傳進父親耳裡⋯⋯。 中影「健康寫實」製片路線首作，也是首部全台人自製彩色寬銀幕電影，由華慧英掌鏡。健康寫實雖借鑑義大利新寫實主義，卻同時受官方意識形態與商業考量牽引，既向《慾海奇花》取經勞動大場面，也以健美高挑的王莫愁遙映《河孃淚》的蘇菲亞羅蘭，從而成就健康意識與場面奇觀、身體情慾並行的混雜之作。本次以正確寬銀幕比例放映，坊間難得一見。 In a coastal Taiwanese village, a young oyster farmer struggles to support her family while pursuing love with a local fisherman. As financial pressures and family obligations threaten their future, their relationship faces mounting challenges. Blending coastal labour, melodrama, and sensual imagery, this landmark of Taiwan’s "Healthy Realism" cinema reveals the movement’s tension between ideological agendas and commercial appeal.

synopsis: 榮民之子伍子明學成歸國，巧遇潑辣漁女，竟是房東女兒周小梅。子明聽從父意，留在新生地為農田設計水渠，與小梅朝夕相處，海濱散步，漸生情愫。然而，伍父盼子明與同鄉護士交往，周母對女兒的郎君人選亦另有屬意，子明動了他念，小梅卻執意追愛。村裡謠言四起、工程遭人反對，這段感情終將歸向何處？ 黨國元老吳忠信之子吳申叔出資，委由中影攝製的寬銀幕大作。以新竹海埔新生地為背景，捕捉海岸實景、展示集體勞動，已見健康寫實概念雛形。然而影片對身體與慾望的感官呈現，既透出歐日電影風情，亦顯現彼時台灣青年的束縛。攝影師洪慶雲回憶受《男人之禁地》第三集《紅短褲》啟發，試驗水中攝影並於片中實踐。本片歷經60多年，迎來大銀幕首獻。 After his studies overseas, a young engineer meets a spirited fisherwoman who turns out to be his landlady’s daughter. At his father’s urging, he stays in a newly reclaimed coastal settlement to design irrigation channels, and the two gradually fall in love. But parental expectations, competing romantic prospects, village gossip, and opposition to the construction project threaten to derail their burgeoning romance. The film’s planned 1960 release never materialised. After six decades on the shelf, this hidden gem finally makes its big-screen debut.

synopsis_en:
Wu Zi-ming, the son of a veteran, returns home after completing his studies abroad and encounters a feisty fisherwoman who turns out to be his landlady’s daughter, Chou Hsiao-mei. At his father’s request, Zi-ming stays in the newly reclaimed land to design irrigation channels for the farmland. Spending their days together and taking walks along the shore, he and Hsiao-mei gradually develop feelings for one another. However, Zi-ming’s father hopes he will date a nurse from their hometown, while Hsiao-mei’s mother has another suitor in mind for her daughter. As Zi-ming begins to waver, Hsiao-mei remains determined to pursue her love. With village gossip swirling and opposition mounting against the engineering project, where will their relationship lead?

This widescreen epic was funded by Wu Shen-shu, son of the Kuomintang elder Wu Zhong-xin, and commissioned to the Central Motion Picture Corporation (CMPC). Set against the backdrop of Hsinchu’s reclaimed coastal land, the film captures authentic seaside scenery and collective labor, showcasing the early seeds of the "Healthy Realism" movement. Yet, its sensory portrayal of the body and desire reflects both European and Japanese cinematic influences, as well as the societal constraints faced by Taiwanese youth at the time. Cinematographer Hung Ching-yun recalled being inspired by *Red Shorts* (the third installment of the documentary *Forbidden Paradise*) to experiment with and implement underwater photography in the film. After more than 60 years, this film finally makes its big-screen debut.

tmdb_overview: 「初戀，永遠讓人刻骨銘心」。  在在熱鬧的嘉年華會夜晚，年輕貌美的艾莉認識了帥氣可愛的諾亞，這是甜美難忘的初戀，雖然家世背景不同，但他們彼此吸引、無法自拔。然而，二次世界大戰突然爆發，無情的烽火硬生生迫使兩人離散。日復一日，艾莉痴痴等待諾亞7年，戰爭結束後，仍然沒有他的消息。  一名事業有成的青年，對艾莉展開真誠熱切的追求，並且提出求婚。艾莉答應了，偏偏又在報上赫然看見關於諾亞的消息。這個意外彷彿晴天霹靂，艾莉忐忑不安，最後決定獨自走向那棟有200年歷史的老房子。她想知道，諾亞回來了嗎？是否安然無恙？是否仍深愛著她？
tmdb_overview_en: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded notebook, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.
